paper: Batch and Match: Black-Box Variational Inference with a Score-Based Divergence

conditions.statement: 변분 분포족은 완전 공분산(full covariance)을 갖는 가우시안이며, 분해형(mean-field) 분포족을 쓰지 않는다.
conditions.quote: We study the score-based divergence for Gaussian variational families with full covariance, rather than the factorized family.
conditions.note: Sec 1 (Introduction); restated in Sec 5 (p.9) for all compared methods. Family Q = {N(mu, Sigma): Sigma symmetric positive definite} in Sec 2.2.

alts.quote: Here we focus on a Gaussian variational family, i.e., Q ={N (µ, Σ) :µ∈ RD, Σ∈ SD ++}

review.why: the Gaussian family with Σ in S++: full covariance

conditions.statement: batch 단계: 현재 근사 q_t=N(µ_t,Σ_t)에서 B개 표본 z_b를 뽑아 목표 score g_b=∇log p(z_b)를 계산하고, 표본과 score의 배치 평균(z̄, ḡ)과 공분산(C, Γ)을 구한다.
conditions.quote: This step begins by samplingz1,z 2,...,z B ∼ qt and computing the scores gb =∇ logp(zb) at each sample. It then calculates the means and covariances (over the batch)
conditions.note: Sec 3.1 'Batch Step', eqs (6)-(7) and Algorithm 1 steps 3-5 (p.6). Batch covariances C and Gamma use 1/B normalization.

alts.quote: In the “batch” step, we draw a batch of samples from the current approximation to the target
alts.note: the batch step in the introduction; quoted by the 2026-10-20 run (item 2), paired by the measuring session

review.why: the batch step: samples drawn from the current approximation

alts.quote: Sample batch zb∼N (µt, Σt) for b = 1,...,B
alts.note: Algorithm 1: sample a batch from N(µt, Σt); quoted by the 2026-10-20 run (item 8), paired by the measuring session

review.why: Algorithm 1 line 3, the sampling the condition starts with

conditions.statement: match 단계: 경험적 score 기반 발산 D̂_{q_t}(q;p)에 KL(q_t;q)의 2/λ_t 배를 정규화항으로 더한 목적함수 L_BaM(q)를 최소화해 q_{t+1}을 구한다(λ_t는 학습률 역할).
conditions.quote: Importantly, this minimization is subject to a regularizer: we penalize large differences betweenqt and qt+1 by their KL divergence.
conditions.note: Sec 3.1 eq. (5): L_BaM(q) = D_hat_{q_t}(q;p) + (2/lambda_t) KL(q_t;q); the 2/lambda_t weight is in the equation on the same page, not in this quote.

alts.quote: we computeqt+1 by minimizing theregularized objective function L BaM(q) := bDqt(q;p) + 2 λt KL(qt;q)
alts.note: the regularized objective L_BaM with the 2/λt KL term; quoted by the 2026-10-20 run (item 5), paired by the measuring session

review.why: eq. (5) itself, the objective the condition states

alts.quote: We refer to the minimization of L BaM(q) in eq. (5) as the match step

review.why: minimizing L_BaM of eq. (5) is the match step

conditions.statement: match 단계는 닫힌 형태로 푼다: U=λ_tΓ+λ_t/(1+λ_t)ḡḡᵀ, V=Σ_t+λ_tC+λ_t/(1+λ_t)(µ_t−z̄)(µ_t−z̄)ᵀ로 Σ_{t+1}=2V[I+(I+4UV)^{1/2}]^{-1}을 먼저 구하고, 그 Σ_{t+1}로 µ_{t+1}=µ_t/(1+λ_t)+λ_t/(1+λ_t)(Σ_{t+1}ḡ+z̄)를 계산한다.
conditions.quote: The solution in eq. (12) is the BaM update for the variational covariance. The update for the variational mean is given by
conditions.note: Sec 3.1 eqs (9)-(13) and Algorithm 1 steps 6-7. Same page states the order requirement: 'Note that the update for mu_t+1 depends on Sigma_t+1, so these updates must be performed in the order shown above.' A low-rank solver (Lemma B.3) is an equivalent implementation; reviewer may split this into two conditions.

alts.quote: The quadratic matrix equation in eq. (9) has a symmetric and positive-definite solution
alts.note: the covariance update solves the quadratic matrix equation; quoted by the 2026-10-20 run (item 6), paired by the measuring session

review.why: the covariance update as the positive-definite solution, eq. (12) follows

alts.quote: Note that the update forµt+1 depends on Σt+1, so these updates must be performed in the order shown above
alts.note: µ is updated after Σ, in that order; quoted by the 2026-10-20 run (item 7), paired by the measuring session

review.why: µ after Σ: the order the condition requires

conditions.statement: 가우시안 목표분포의 차원은 D = 4, 16, 64, 256이다.
conditions.quote: We construct Gaussian targets of increasing dimension withD =4, 16, 64, 256.
conditions.note: Sec 5.1 'Gaussian targets with increasing dimensions'. The wallclock study (Fig E.1) also uses D=128, but that is an extra timing analysis.

conditions.statement: 가우시안 목표분포는 무작위로 생성하며, 공분산은 D×D 행렬 A를 생성해 Σ* = AAᵀ로 만든다.
conditions.quote: Each target distribution was generated randomly; here the covariance was constructed by generating aD×D matrix A and computing Σ∗ =AA⊤.
conditions.note: Appendix E.3. The distribution of A's entries and how the target mean is chosen are not stated in the paper; reviewer should confirm nothing more is specified.

conditions.statement: 가우시안 목표 실험에서 모든 알고리즘은 µ0 ~ uniform[0, 0.1], Σ0 = I로 초기화한다.
conditions.quote: For all experiments, the algorithms were initialized withµ0∼ uniform[0, 0.1] and Σ0 =I.
conditions.note: Appendix E.3 (Gaussian targets). The same init is stated for posteriordb in Appendix E.5 (p.46); sinh-arcsinh uses a random mu0 and Sigma0=I (Appendix E.4, p.45). Reviewer may add those as separate conditions.

conditions.statement: 가우시안 목표 실험에서 BaM은 상수 학습률 λ_t = BD를 쓴다.
conditions.quote: In all of these experiments, we use a constant learning rateλt =BD for BaM.
conditions.note: Sec 5.1. Appendix E.3 (Fig E.2) also tries lambda_t = B, BD, B/(t+1), BD/(t+1) and finds constant rates best for Gaussian targets; that is an ablation.

conditions.statement: 가우시안 목표 실험의 BaM 배치 크기는 그림 5.1 범례 기준 D=4에서 B=2와 5, D=16에서 2와 15, D=64에서 2와 40, D=256에서 2와 150이다.
conditions.quote: ADVI, Score, Fisher, and GSM use a batch size ofB =2. The batch size for BaM is given in the legend.
conditions.note: Fig 5.1 caption; the values come from the legend text on p.10 ('D=4 BaM-5 BaM-2', 'D=16 BaM-15 BaM-2', 'D=64 BaM-40 BaM-2', 'D=256 BaM-150 BaM-2'), not from a sentence. Double-check against the figure.

conditions.statement: 가우시안 목표 실험의 곡선은 10회 실행의 평균이다.
conditions.quote: Fig 5.1: Gaussian targets of increasing dimension. Solid curves indicate the mean over 10 runs (transparent curves).
conditions.note: Fig 5.1 caption (also Fig E.3). The sinh-arcsinh Fig 5.2 is likewise a mean over 10 runs with standard-error bands (p.11); posteriordb Fig 5.3 is a mean over 5 runs (p.12). Total iterations per run are not stated; x-axis reaches about 10^4 gradient evaluations.

conditions.statement: 합성 목표(가우시안·sinh-arcsinh) 실험의 평가지표는 forward KL(p;q)와 reverse KL(q;p)의 경험적 추정치이다.
conditions.quote: As evaluation metrics, we use empirical estimates of the KL divergence in both the forward direction,KL(p;q), and the reverse direction, KL(q;p).
conditions.note: Sec 5.1. Main-text figures (5.1, 5.2) show forward KL; reverse KL is in Appendix E.3/E.4 (Figs E.3, E.4). How the KL estimates are computed (sample count) is not stated.

conditions.statement: 알고리즘 비용은 gradient evaluation 횟수로 측정하며, 지표를 이 횟수에 대해 그린다.
conditions.quote: In the main paper, we report the number of gradient evaluations as a measure of the cost of the algorithm.
conditions.note: Appendix E.2. Figs 5.1-5.3 use '# gradient evaluations' on the x-axis. The deep generative model experiment instead plots MSE against iterations (Fig 5.4b) and wallclock time (Fig E.7).

conditions.statement: 비가우시안 목표는 y~N(µ,Σ)를 z = sinh((1/τ)(sinh⁻¹(y) + s))로 변환한 sinh-arcsinh 분포이며, s는 skew, τ>0는 꼬리 두께를 정한다(s=0, τ=1이면 가우시안).
conditions.quote: where the parameterss∈ R and τ> 0 control, respectively, the skew and the heaviness of the tails. The Gaussian distribution is recovered whens=0 and τ =1.
conditions.note: Sec 5.1 'Non-Gaussian targets with varying skew and tails'. The parameters (mu, Sigma) of the base Gaussian y are not stated.

alts.quote: The sinh-arcsinh normal distribution trans-forms a Gaussian random variable via the hyperbolic sine function and its inverse
alts.note: the sinh-arcsinh normal target; quoted by the 2026-10-20 run (item 15), paired by the measuring session

review.why: defines the target the condition names

conditions.statement: sinh-arcsinh 목표분포의 차원은 D = 10이다.
conditions.quote: Hereweagainconsiderthesinh-arcsinhdistributionwith D = 10, where we vary the skew and tails.
conditions.note: Appendix E.4; the dimension appears only in the appendix (also Fig E.5 caption). Text extraction collapsed spaces in this span.

conditions.statement: skew 실험은 꼬리 τ = 1로 고정하고 s = 0.2, 1.0, 1.8로 바꾼다.
conditions.quote: First, we construct target distributions with normal tails (t = 1) but varying skew (s = 0.2, 1.0, 1.8).
conditions.note: Sec 5.1; the PDF extraction renders tau as 't'. Fig 5.2 top row and Fig E.4.

conditions.statement: 꼬리 실험은 s = 0으로 고정하고 τ = 0.1, 0.9, 1.7로 바꾼다.
conditions.quote: Next we construct target distributions with no skew (s = 0) but tails of varying heaviness (t=0.1, 0.9, 1.7).
conditions.note: Sec 5.1; 't' is tau in the PDF extraction. Fig 5.2 bottom row.

conditions.statement: sinh-arcsinh 목표에서 BaM은 감소 학습률 λ_t = BD/(t+1)을 쓴다.
conditions.quote: Here we use a decaying learning rateλt = BD/(t+1) for BaM, as some decay is necessary for BaM to converge when the target distribution is non-Gaussian.
conditions.note: Sec 5.1. Appendix E.4 (Fig E.5) compares BD, BD/sqrt(t+1), BD/(t+1) and reports BD/(t+1) typically converges faster.

conditions.statement: sinh-arcsinh 실험의 BaM 배치 크기는 그림 5.2 범례 기준 B = 5와 B = 10이다.
conditions.quote: Forward KL s=0.2, =1.0 BaM-10 BaM-5 GSM Score Fisher ADVI
conditions.note: Fig 5.2 legend text (tau symbol lost in extraction); values come from the legend, not a sentence. Baselines use B=5 per the Fig 5.2 caption. Double-check against the figure.

conditions.statement: posteriordb의 첫 번째 목표는 거의 가우시안인 arK 모델(D = 7)이다.
conditions.quote: The first target is nearly Gaussian (arK, D =7).
conditions.note: Sec 5.2; the three targets come from posteriordb (Magnusson et al., 2022), Stan models with HMC reference samples.

conditions.statement: posteriordb의 비가우시안 목표는 GP 포아송 회귀 gp-pois-regr(D = 13)와 8-schools 계층 모델 eight-schools-centered(D = 10)이다.
conditions.quote: one is a Gaussian process (GP) Poisson regression model (gp-pois-regr, D =13), and the other is the 8-schools hierarchical Bayesian model (eight-schools-centered, D =10).
conditions.note: Sec 5.2.

conditions.statement: posteriordb 실험의 지표는 HMC 참조 표본에서 얻은 사후 평균·표준편차에 대한 변분 추정치의 상대 평균 오차와 상대 SD 오차이다.
conditions.value: relative mean error, relative SD error
conditions.quote: we evaluate BaM, ADVI, and GSM by computing the relative errors of the posterior mean and standard deviation (SD) estimates with respect to those from HMC samples
conditions.note: Sec 5.2; definitions in Appendix E.5 eq. (242): relative mean error = ||(mu - mu_hat)/sigma||_2, relative SD error = ||(sigma - sigma_hat)/sigma||_2, with mu, sigma from HMC reference samples. Main Fig 5.3 shows relative mean error; SD error is in Fig E.6.

alts.quote: reference samples generated using Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC)

review.why: HMC reference samples, without the relative-error metric

conditions.statement: posteriordb 실험에서 BaM은 감소 학습률 λ_t = BD/(t+1)을 쓴다.
conditions.quote: Appendix E.5. We use a decaying learning rateλt =BD/(t+1) for BaM.
conditions.note: Sec 5.2. Quote starts at the tail of the previous sentence to keep it distinct from the near-identical sinh-arcsinh sentence on p.10.

conditions.statement: posteriordb 실험의 배치 크기는 B = 8과 B = 32이다.
conditions.quote: Figure 5.3 compares the relative mean errors of BaM, ADVI, and GSM for batch sizesB =8 and B =32.
conditions.note: Sec 5.2; the same two batch sizes are used for ADVI and GSM. Fig 5.3 caption (p.12): mean over 5 runs with standard-error bands. Init mu0 ~ uniform[0,0.1], Sigma0=I (Appendix E.5, p.46).

conditions.statement: 심층 생성모델은 z_n~N(0,I), x_n|z_n~N(Ω(z_n,θ̂), σ²I)이고 σ² = 0.1로 둔다.
conditions.quote: The neural networkΩ is parameterized byˆθ and mapszn to the mean of the likelihoodp(xn|zn). For this example, we setσ2 = 0.1.

conditions.statement: 신경망은 CIFAR-10으로 학습하며, 이미지를 연속값 x_n ∈ R^3072로, 잠재변수를 z_n ∈ R^256으로 둔다.
conditions.quote: We train the neural network on the CIFAR-10 image data set (Krizhevsky, 2009). We model the images as continuous, withxn∈ R3072, and learn a latent representationzn∈ R256
conditions.note: Sec 5.3. Decoder Omega(., theta_hat) is pre-trained as a VAE (variational EM with a factorized-Gaussian amortized encoder), 5-layer convolutional networks, 100 epochs (Appendix E.6, p.48).

conditions.statement: 사후분포를 추정할 새 관측 x′는 테스트 세트에서 뽑은 이미지이며, 모든 VI 알고리즘은 표준 가우시안에서 초기화한다.
conditions.value: x′ from test set; init N(0, I)
conditions.quote: For the estimation of the posterior on a new observation, we draw an imagex′ from the test set. All VI algorithms are initialized at a standard Gaussian.
conditions.note: Appendix E.6. The number of test images / runs for Fig 5.4 is not stated.

conditions.statement: 심층 생성모델의 지표는 사후 기댓값 E[z′|x′]을 신경망 Ω에 넣어 얻은 x′ 복원의 평균제곱오차(MSE)이다.
conditions.quote: we examine how wellx′ is reconstructed by feeding the posterior expectationE[z′|x′] into the neural networkΩ(·, ˆθ). The quality of the reconstruction is assessed visually and using the mean squared error
conditions.note: Sec 5.3; Fig 5.4b plots MSE against iterations for B = 10, 100, 300.

conditions.statement: 심층 생성모델 실험에서 BaM은 T = 100 반복의 파일럿 실행으로 학습률을 고른 뒤 T = 1000 반복 실행한다.
conditions.quote: For ADVI and BaM, we use a pilot run ofT = 100iterations to find a suitable learning rate; we then run the algorithms forT = 1000iterations.
conditions.note: Sec 5.3. Appendix E.6 (p.48): the pilot picks the learning rate with lowest MSE for each B = 10, 100, 300; selected BaM lambda: B=10 -> 0.1, B=100 -> 50, B=300 -> 7500. Reviewer may add the batch sizes and selected lambda as separate conditions.

conditions.statement: 가우시안 목표에서 BaM은 ADVI보다 수 자릿수(orders of magnitude) 빠르게 수렴한다.
conditions.value: orders of magnitude faster than ADVI
conditions.quote: Overall, we find that BaM converges orders of magnitude faster than ADVI.
conditions.note: Sec 5.1, Fig 5.1 (forward KL vs gradient evaluations). Qualitative magnitude read off plots; no table of numbers.

conditions.statement: 심층 생성모델에서 배치 크기가 잠재 차원과 비슷한 B = 300일 때 BaM은 ADVI와 GSM보다 한 자릿수 이상 빠르게 수렴한다.
conditions.value: B = 300: ≥1 order of magnitude faster than ADVI and GSM
conditions.quote: When the batch size is comparable to the dimension ofzn (i.e. B =300), BaM converges an order of magnitude (or more) faster than ADVI and GSM.
conditions.note: Sec 5.3, Fig 5.4. The same paragraph also states: under a 3000-gradient-evaluation budget, ADVI's lowest MSE is at B=10, T=300 while BaM gives a comparable result at B=300, T=10; reviewer may add it as a third result.
